liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates the Shakedown Street performance as good, along with Playin' in the Band, in a short second set; Reviewer says Shakedown Street rescued a set that would otherwise seem lame [5][11]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Garcia's jam in Playin' outrageous; Reviewer calls the whole Playing sandwich a delight [11][14]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Mickey spoke to Bob after a mistake in El Paso [13]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Reviewer loves the long jam in this song [9]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Called the high point of an otherwise unremarkable first set [5]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed some excellent spacey playing in the second set [6]

## The recordings

- **gd78-12-13.sbd.hinko.22145.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard sound worn and unimpressive; Reviewer says the recording's sound recalls early bootleg tapes; Reviewer finds this soundboard warmer and drier, with less glisten than typical late-1970s recordings [5][9][14]
- **gd78-12-13.sbd.miller.25717.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this soundboard transfer muddy and heavily filtered, and says to avoid it; Reviewer hears Phil clearly in the mix, with Keith standing out and the overall sound good [4][8]
- **gd78-12-13.aud.wiley.9478.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this audience recording pretty good [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the other soundboard source of this show is far better than this one [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-12-13.sbd.hinko.22145.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Chain runs soundboard to cassette, reel, DAT, CD, then EAC and SHN; transfer by Darryl Hinko; Gaps were patched with an audience recording via cassette and DAT to CDR; hiss reduction was applied [1]
- **gd78-12-13.sbd.miller.25717.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd78-12-13.aud.wiley.9478.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1978-12-13 Curtis Hixon Convention Hall, Tampa, FL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-12-13-curtis-hixon-convention-hall-tampa-fl-usa/) [16]
